name: gate-waiver-flag-refused
definition: [P2] the verify gate honours no local skip flag: setting SKIP_TDD_LEDGER, SKIP_COVERAGE, SKIP_ASSERT_DENSITY and similar to 1 is itself counted as a failed check, so an agent cannot waive a test gate to get green
evidence: qyndex/claude-init .claude/scripts/verify.sh:42-50 (skip_honored() { return 1; }; '$v requested: trusted waiver unavailable'; fails=$((fails+1)))

name: expected-failure-marker
definition: [P1+P2] the red test lands marked as an expected failure (xfail/fixme/known-bug block) that keeps running; the fix is proven only when the marked test flips to pass (xpass) and the marker is removed, and an unexpected pass flags the marker as stale
evidence: OpenHands/OpenHands .agents/skills/verify-openhands/SKILL.md:202-214 ('bug run <ID> --attempts 2 --label baseline' must report xfail, fix must report xpass), :244-246; Significant-Gravitas/AutoGPT .claude/skills/pr-test/SKILL.md:1289 ('write a test marked with pytest.mark.xfail ... confirm it fails'), :1301 ('Remove the xfail/fixme marker ... and verify it passes')

name: repeat-run-consistency
definition: [P1+P2] a red or a green counts only when it reproduces across repeated runs (N consecutive passes, red reproduced at least twice, baseline/fix each confirmed twice); a single flaky result, or a failure waved off as a flake, is not accepted
evidence: qyndex/claude-init .claude/scripts/tdd-ledger.sh:17-18, 149-166 (TDD_GREEN_RUNS=N, every run must pass); kt-cloud-tech-up-gen-ai/k-manner-speech-api .agents/skills/sc-tdd-backend/SKILL.md:20 ('Reproduce the same red at least twice'); OpenHands/OpenHands .agents/skills/verify-openhands/SKILL.md:210-211 ('A baseline that does not reproduce twice is inconclusive, never fixed'); Significant-Gravitas/AutoGPT .claude/skills/pr-test/SKILL.md:1278 ('Never approve if any scenario failed, even if it seems like a flake — rerun that scenario first')

name: same-command-red-green
definition: [P1+P2] the command that judges red and green is fixed in advance and must be identical in both runs (and match the task's accept command); the agent may not narrow, filter or swap the test command between red and green
evidence: anudeeps28/claude-code-harness agents/story-executor-agent.md:110 ('Run the exact command from <verify>. Do not modify it.'); qyndex/claude-init .claude/scripts/check-tdd-ledger.sh:14-15, 103-104 ('command differs between red and green (must prove the SAME test)'); tomMoulard/configLoader claude/skills/repro-test-first/SKILL.md:30 ('Run the *same* command again; show it passing')

name: failing-placeholder-stub
definition: [P2] generated test skeletons raise NotImplementedError in the body, so an unfilled placeholder test fails instead of passing vacuously

name: coverage-no-decrease
definition: [P2] coverage is compared against the previous baseline and a drop fails the check or blocks merge (a ratchet, not a fixed threshold)
evidence: khalilbenaz/claude-skills-collection skills/dev-tdd-coach/SKILL.md:206 ('CI gate : bloquer le merge si la couverture de test chute'); Agistra/agistra.dev skills/test-driven-development/SKILL.md:332 ('Coverage hasn't decreased (if tracked)'); xeho91/.dotfiles agents/skills/test-driven-development/SKILL.md:396
